items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: here was a name I knew, but I'd never met the man.

ctx.x: On the -- on the -- one of our trips, you know, like, our first trip out of town, we had the bus, and we were on our way to St. Louis. And, Louis says, "Well, now, wait a minute." He says, "I want the bus driver, I want you to drive around, I'll tell you where to go, because we got to go see Freddy Keppert, because Freddy --
